company.name: MyZoi
company.shortDescription: MyZoi is a financial company that provide financial inclusion for banked and unbanked firms.
company.description: myZoi is a fintech company focused on financial inclusion for underbanked workers, offering digital payroll solutions, remittances, and financial literacy tools. It enables employers to pay salaries digitally while helping employees access secure wallets, lower-cost money transfers, and better financial management services. The platform is designed to improve access to banking services, reduce transaction costs, and support migrant workers and their families with more transparent, efficient, and accessible financial systems.
